Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for taking time on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- You’ll initiate the SIG/CAIQ path for Mediwave's vendor review (your team prefers SIG).
- You asked for our SOC 2 scope and whether we have a Type II report available — short answer: we are SOC 2 Type II in production; I’ll attach the standard attestation and provide a note on the date range.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-controlled deployments; for product-level safeguards we’ll map the controls you flagged (audit logging, encryption at-rest/in-transit, access controls).
- Data residency: you mentioned EU data residency for certain PHI flows — can you confirm whether the initial PoC will process EU-resident data or if routing will remain US-only?

Attached is a one-sheet prefill (Mediwave_SIG_initial.xlsx) that walks through the SIG sections we expect you to request. If you prefer a custom form instead of CAIQ, flag which additional fields you need and we’ll prioritize.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm SIG vs custom questionnaire and the data residency requirement by end of day Fri (7/20).
2) We provide SOC 2 Type II attestation + evidence mapping document by Mon (7/22).
3) Kickoff call with our security ops + your security contact to walk the evidence map (I can coordinate times).

If that timeline doesn’t work, tell me the window that does and I’ll adjust.

Best,
Ben

Thanks Ben — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SIG is preferred by our security ops, but we may add a small custom appendix for PHI-specific controls. I’ll confirm by EOD Friday.
- SOC 2: good to hear you’re Type II. We need the report covering at least the last 12 months; can you confirm the attestation period and whether the report contains a description of exclusions (if any)?
- HIPAA: our privacy team needs a brief statement of what parts of the product are within your HIPAA-controlled offering (e.g., ingestion pipeline, storage, viewer). Can you provide a mapped list?
- Data residency: for the PoC, we expect only US data. However, if we move to production we’ll require EU residency for EU patient records. Please note that as a potential future requirement.

Timeline: if you can share the attestation + evidence mapping by Monday that would be ideal. Also, can we schedule the security ops walkthrough for the week of 7/30? Our security lead (security@mediwave.com) is available 7/31–8/2 afternoons ET.

Appreciate it — Alyssa

- HIPAA_product_scope.md (short doc listing product components and which deployment models include them)
- requested_evidence_matrix.csv (expanded mapping of SIG sections => artifacts)

3) Data residency note: understood — we’ll flag EU residency as a future requirement and include recommended options (VPC private deployment or EU cloud region for dedicated capacity).

4) Timeline & kickoff: we can deliver the attestation stub + evidence matrix by Mon 2028-07-22 COB PT. For the walkthrough, 7/31 3:00–4:00pm ET works for our security ops. I’ll send a calendar invite when Ben confirms.

Questions for Mediwave before the walkthrough: 
- Do you want a scanned, signed PDF of the SOC report or is a downloadable redacted PDF acceptable?
- Will you need support-level encryption key details (KMS provider) in the evidence pack or is a high-level description sufficient?
